editionLabel: Hans im Glück / Z-Man 2013 English base game
firstPlayerRule: Shuffle the four numbered Turn Order cards and deal one face up to each player. Put each player’s pawn on the matching turn-order space. The player in the leftmost occupied position takes the first turn; the others follow track order rather than clockwise seating order.
clarifications: The rulebook recommends dealing the cards blindly because their backs differ.
The two- and three-player setup changes do not replace the turn-order card method.
Later rounds can reorganize turn order through spaces on the track.
interpretation: With fewer than four players, use the leftmost occupied turn-order position. This follows the track-order rule when some numbered spaces are empty.
